summary.text: Deb Krishnadasan is a Democratic member of the Washington State Senate from District 26, appointed on December 11, 2024, and she is seeking election to the seat on November 3, 2026 against Gary Parker (R).
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said her career included work at Microsoft and that she served two terms on the Peninsula School Board, including as president.

paragraphs.text: Krishnadasan earned a bachelor's degree from Western Washington University.
Her career experience includes working for the Cystic Fibrosis Foundation and in communications at Microsoft.
In the Ballotpedia survey, she said she grew up on a family farm in Puyallup in a union household and was the first person in her family to graduate from college.
The Kitsap Board of Commissioners and the Pierce County Council appointed Krishnadasan to Senate District 26 to replace Emily Randall (D).

In the 2023-2024 session she served on the Early Learning & K-12 Education, Agriculture, Water, Natural Resources & Parks, and Senate Transportation committees, and was vice chair of the State Government and Tribal Affairs Committee.
In the August 4, 2026 primary she received 56.6% of the vote to Parker's 43.3%.
In the survey, she listed affordability, education and opportunity among her priorities, and said she passed seven bipartisan bills in her first term.
